About_&_Key_Points:
About
Incorporated in 2008, HMA Agro Industries Limited is a food trade organization for handled food and agro products including frozen fresh buffalo meat, prepared/frozen natural products, vegetables, and cereals in India.
[1]
Key Points
Leading Meat Exporter
The company is one of the largest manufacturers and exporters of Frozen Boneless Buffalo meat, Seafood, Pet Food, Rice, and processed leather from India, with an export volume worth approximately USD 0.5 billion. It is recognized as a Star Export House by the Government of India with a 10-11% estimated market share.
